hero.title: Executive MBA in Finland for International Students
hero.subtitle: Experience world-class academic training and global career pathways in Finland with Edu-Hawk Worldwide.

overview: Finland offers executive education options through institutions such as Aalto University, Hanken & SSE Executive Education and Turku School of Economics Executive Education. These programmes are generally designed to be completed alongside professional responsibilities, allowing participants to apply their learning to real business challenges.

faq.question: Can international students study an Executive MBA in Finland?
faq.answer: Yes. International applicants can explore programmes such as the Aalto Executive MBA, Hanken Executive MBA and TSE EXE Executive MBA. Admission depends on the programme’s professional experience, educational background, language and selection requirements.

faq.question: What is the duration of an Executive MBA in Finland?
faq.answer: Many Finnish Executive MBA programmes take approximately two years and are designed to be completed alongside professional work. Some programmes may have different schedules or longer completion periods.

faq.question: What is the cost of an Executive MBA in Finland?
faq.answer: The published programme fees featured in this guide range from €44,800 to €52,000 before applicable VAT for the selected EMBA options. This is approximately ₹48.65 lakh to ₹56.47 lakh at the indicative exchange rate used here. Travel, accommodation and other expenses may be additional.

faq.question: Is an Executive MBA the same as a regular MBA?
faq.answer: No. An Executive MBA is generally designed for experienced professionals and often uses a part-time or modular format. A regular MBA may have different entry requirements and study structures. Applicants should also check whether the qualification is an academic master

faq.question: Do I need work experience for an Executive MBA in Finland?
faq.answer: Professional experience is an important requirement for most Executive MBA programmes. The exact amount varies by institution. The published TSE EXE EMBA requirements, for example, specify at least five years of relevant demanding specialist or managerial experience, or equivalent leadership experience.
